explanatorySections.title: How to use this planner
body: Answer a few questions about your address, household, arrival timing, and how soon you need banking. Generate prioritized first-week and first-month tasks, appointment-sensitive items, and reminders.
For phase explanations and edge cases, read the After Arriving guide. Continue with the First 90 Days Planner for weeks 2–12.

introParagraphs: This interactive Arrival Planner builds a personalized first-week and first-month task sequence for the Netherlands. It is a planning tool — pair it with the After Arriving guide for full context.

disclosure: This planner is for general relocation planning only. It is not legal, immigration, tax, or financial advice. Confirm your exact requirements with official sources and your local municipality.
